surfaces.label: 轨道货运接口清空
surfaces.reason: Rust special-input-port command owns clearing and refunds.

surfaces.label: 轨道空间站操作
surfaces.reason: Rust orbital-contract command owns the native workspace mutations.

surfaces.label: 基础制造
surfaces.reason: Handcraft enqueue and cancellation still need one native semantic command family.

surfaces.label: 建筑放置与扩建
surfaces.reason: Ordinary placement, blueprint deployment and construction queue use Rust commands.

surfaces.label: 建筑回收
surfaces.reason: Rust removal contexts and authoritative refunds are wired.

surfaces.label: 建筑升级
surfaces.reason: Single and selected upgrade targets need a Rust-derived upgrade command.

surfaces.label: 建筑拖放
surfaces.reason: Bounded native position commands own ordinary dragging.

surfaces.label: 建筑位置编辑
surfaces.reason: Rust validates and commits exact position leaves.

surfaces.label: 建筑物资交互
surfaces.reason: Factory inventory projection and typed transfer commands are authoritative.

surfaces.label: 建筑与线路回收
surfaces.reason: Combined selection removal needs one atomic semantic command.

surfaces.label: 建筑制造中心
surfaces.reason: Construction automation and queue commands own native mutations.

surfaces.label: 旧版游戏规则设置
surfaces.reason: Legacy rules are not part of the Windows player-authority contract.

surfaces.label: 蓝图部署
surfaces.reason: Rust direct-deploy and enqueue commands own blueprint deployment.

surfaces.label: 蓝图复制
surfaces.reason: Rust capture/import/export contexts own native blueprints.

surfaces.label: 蓝图施工订单取消
surfaces.reason: Rust queue cancellation owns refunds and version pruning.

surfaces.label: 喷涂模块拆卸
surfaces.reason: A typed module-detach command with exact refund remains.

surfaces.label: 批量回收
surfaces.reason: Selected entity and belt removal must be atomic in Rust.

surfaces.label: 批量接入量子物流
surfaces.reason: Rust must derive eligible entities and attachment cost from the current revision.

surfaces.label: 批量拉线
surfaces.reason: Continuous geometry candidates need one bounded Rust command.

surfaces.label: 批量切换轨道采集器量子模式
surfaces.reason: Collector eligibility and inventory accounting remain to be derived by Rust.

surfaces.label: 批量升级星际物流站
surfaces.reason: Station upgrade costs and fleet limits need a native batch command.

surfaces.label: 批量增加建筑与线路
surfaces.reason: Stack and lane changes need a selection semantic command.

surfaces.label: 生产区域编辑
surfaces.reason: Persisted regions need typed Rust leaf commands; viewport-only state stays local.

surfaces.label: 施工库存删除
surfaces.reason: Permanent discard requires Rust accounting and explicit confirmation.

surfaces.label: 手动采矿
surfaces.reason: Rust manual-mining intent derives yield and depletion.

surfaces.label: 托盘与手持物
surfaces.reason: Special tray, hand and cross-container moves are only partially covered.

surfaces.label: 微型黑洞启停
surfaces.reason: Rust black-hole pause intent owns activation and pause state.

surfaces.label: 物料配送接口设置
surfaces.reason: Rust special-input-port command owns configuration and refunds.

surfaces.label: 系统空间站输出口设置
surfaces.reason: Rust station command owns output-port configuration.

surfaces.label: 远程轨道采集物设置
surfaces.reason: Collector item assignment needs a typed native command.

surfaces.label: 远程物流槽位设置
surfaces.reason: Rust station-slot intents own item and mode configuration.

surfaces.label: 运输线创建
surfaces.reason: Ordinary belt placement context and command are authoritative.
